blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A House impeachment prosecutor said Saturday that the alleged lavish credit card spending of Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, is among the key issues the defense must explain when it begins presenting evidence before the Senate impeachment court on Monday, Nov. 9. Bicol Saro Party-list Rep. Terry Ridon raised renewed questions over Carpio’s expenditures, citing dining bills in Japan exceeding ₱200,000 alongside hundreds of thousands of pesos in retail purchases. “Ikatlo, ano ho ’yung paliwanag doon sa credit card transactions ni Atty.
